lessons.description: Name brothers, sisters and spouses, and introduce people politely
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 姓 / 给你介绍一下

grammar.title: Asking a surname: 姓
grammar.note: 姓 (xìng) is a verb: 我姓王 = my surname is Wang. 您贵姓? (lit. 'your honorable surname?') is the polite way to ask. Answer with 我姓…, never 我贵姓 — 贵 is only used for the other person.

grammar.title: Introducing: 给 + person + 介绍一下
grammar.pattern: 我给你介绍一下，这是我哥哥。
grammar.note: 给 marks who receives the introduction. 一下 after a verb softens it: 'let me just introduce…'. Then use 这是… for each person.

grammar.title: Counting siblings: 有 + number + 个
grammar.pattern: 我有两个姐姐、一个弟弟。
grammar.note: Use 有 + number + 个 + family word. The list comma 、 separates items. 你家有几口人? asks how many people are in your family (口 is the measure word for household members).

sentences.en: What is your surname?
My surname is Li; my name is Li Ming.

sentences.zh: 我给大家介绍一下，这是我妻子。
sentences.en: Let me introduce to everyone — this is my wife.

sentences.zh: 我有一个哥哥和两个妹妹。
sentences.en: I have one older brother and two younger sisters.

sentences.zh: 那个男人是我姐姐的丈夫。
sentences.en: That man is my older sister's husband.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello! What is your surname?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我姓张。这是我的家人，我给你介绍一下。
dialogue.en: My surname is Zhang. This is my family — let me introduce them.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 这是我丈夫，那是我们的孩子。
dialogue.en: This is my husband, and that is our child.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你们的孩子真漂亮！你有哥哥吗？
dialogue.en: Your child is really beautiful! Do you have an older brother?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 没有。我有一个姐姐和一个弟弟。
dialogue.en: No. I have one older sister and one younger brother.

readings.title: 我家有五口人
readings.titleEn: There Are Five People in My Family

lines.zh: 我叫王小月，我家有五口人。
lines.en: My name is Wang Xiaoyue. There are five people in my family.

lines.zh: 爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
lines.en: Dad, Mom, my older brother, my younger sister and me.

lines.zh: 我哥哥是医生，他的妻子是老师。
lines.en: My older brother is a doctor; his wife is a teacher.

lines.zh: 哥哥和他的妻子没有孩子，他们住在北京。
lines.en: My brother and his wife have no children; they live in Beijing.

lines.zh: 我妹妹今年八岁，她非常喜欢猫。
lines.en: My younger sister is eight this year. She really likes cats.

lines.zh: 我们家没有猫，所以妹妹每天都去看朋友家的猫。
lines.en: We don't have a cat, so my sister goes to see her friend's cat every day.

lines.zh: 我是学生，我非常喜欢我的家！
lines.en: I'm a student, and I really love my family!

questions.question: 王小月家有几口人？
questions.questionEn: How many people are in Wang Xiaoyue's family?

questions.question: 哥哥的妻子是医生。
questions.questionEn: The older brother's wife is a doctor.

questions.question: 妹妹为什么每天去朋友家？
questions.questionEn: Why does the younger sister go to her friend's home every day?

questions.question: 从这个故事看，王小月很喜欢她的家。
questions.questionEn: From the story, Wang Xiaoyue really likes her family.

lines.zh: 大家好！我给大家介绍一下。
lines.en: Hi everyone! Let me introduce someone.

lines.zh: 这个女人是我的朋友，她姓陈。
lines.en: This woman is my friend; her surname is Chen.

lines.zh: 她是中国人，她有两个孩子，一个儿子，一个女儿。
lines.en: She is Chinese and has two children, a son and a daughter.

lines.zh: 她的丈夫在医院工作，是医生。
lines.en: Her husband works at a hospital as a doctor.

lines.zh: 陈女士说：“大家好！很高兴认识你们。”
lines.en: Ms. Chen said: "Hello everyone! Nice to meet you."

lines.zh: 一个男人问：“您贵姓？”她说：“我姓陈。”
lines.en: A man asked, "What's your surname?" She said, "My surname is Chen."

lines.zh: 陈女士说：“我也给大家介绍一下我的丈夫。”
lines.en: Ms. Chen said: "Let me also introduce my husband to everyone."

questions.question: 陈女士有几个孩子？
questions.questionEn: How many children does Ms. Chen have?

questions.question: 陈女士的丈夫在学校工作。
questions.questionEn: Ms. Chen's husband works at a school.

questions.question: “您贵姓”是问什么？
questions.questionEn: What does "您贵姓" ask about?

questions.question: 陈女士最后想介绍她的丈夫。
questions.questionEn: At the end Ms. Chen wants to introduce her husband.

lessons.description: Talk about your daily routine, hours and finished actions
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 已经…了 / 每…都 / 就

grammar.title: Already: 已经 + verb + 了
grammar.note: 已经 (yǐjīng) goes before the verb and 了 comes at the end. 他已经上班了 = He has already gone to work. To say 'not yet', use 还没 + verb: 我还没起床.

grammar.title: Every: 每 + measure + noun + 都
grammar.note: 每 = every. Add 都 before the verb to stress 'without exception'. 每天 (every day), 每个人 (everyone), 每次 (every time).

grammar.title: Duration: verb + time span
grammar.note: How long something lasts goes AFTER the verb: 睡了七个小时 (slept seven hours). Compare: a point in time (七点) goes BEFORE the verb.

grammar.title: Early: 就
grammar.note: 就 after a time word means 'as early as / already then'. 我六点就起床了 = I got up as early as six. It often pairs with 了.

sentences.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。
sentences.en: I get up at 6:30 every morning.
What time do you go to work?

sentences.zh: 八点开始上课，我七点就到学校了。
sentences.en: Class starts at eight; I already got to school at seven.
I have already finished eating.

sentences.zh: 今天我很累，想休息一个小时。
sentences.en: I'm tired today and want to rest for an hour.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥在一个大公司上班。
sentences.en: My older brother works at a big company.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time do you get up every day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我六点就起床了。洗完脸，我就去跑步。
dialogue.en: I get up at six. After washing my face, I go running.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How long do you run?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 跑一个小时。八点开始上班。
dialogue.en: One hour. I start work at eight.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 现在已经十点了，你还没休息吗？
dialogue.en: It's already ten now — you haven't rested yet?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Not yet, I haven't finished my work.

lines.zh: 我爸爸每天早上五点半就起床了。
lines.en: My dad gets up as early as 5:30 every morning.

lines.zh: 起床以后，他先洗脸，然后吃早饭。
lines.en: After getting up, he washes his face first and then eats breakfast.

lines.zh: 他七点开始上班，每天工作十个小时。
lines.en: He starts work at seven and works ten hours every day.

lines.zh: 他的公司离家很远，坐车要一个小时。
lines.en: His company is far from home; it takes an hour by car.

lines.zh: 晚上回家以后，他已经很累了。
lines.en: When he comes home in the evening, he is already very tired.

lines.zh: 吃完饭，他看一会儿电视就睡觉。
lines.en: After dinner he watches TV for a while and then goes to sleep.

lines.zh: 星期天他不上班，在家休息一天。
lines.en: On Sundays he doesn't work and rests at home all day.

questions.question: 爸爸每天工作几个小时？
questions.questionEn: How many hours does Dad work every day?

questions.question: 爸爸的公司离家很近。
questions.questionEn: Dad's company is close to home.

questions.question: 爸爸晚上为什么很累？
questions.questionEn: Why is Dad tired in the evening?

questions.question: 爸爸每天都去公司上班。
questions.questionEn: Dad goes to the company every single day.

lines.zh: 小明今天很忙，没有时间吃早饭。
lines.en: Xiaoming is very busy today and has no time to eat breakfast.

lines.zh: 他七点半才起床，洗完脸就出门了。
lines.en: He only got up at 7:30 and left right after washing his face.

lines.zh: 八点已经开始上课了，他还没到。
lines.en: Class already started at eight, and he hasn't arrived yet.

lines.zh: 八点二十分，小明才到教室。
lines.en: At 8:20 Xiaoming finally got to the classroom.

lines.zh: 老师说：每个人都要早一点儿来。
lines.en: The teacher said: everyone should come a bit earlier.

lines.zh: 小明说：明天我六点就起床！
lines.en: Xiaoming said: tomorrow I'll get up at six!

lines.zh: 老师笑了：“好，我们明天看看。”
lines.en: The teacher smiled: "OK, we'll see tomorrow."

questions.question: 小明今天几点起床？
questions.questionEn: What time did Xiaoming get up today?

questions.question: 小明今天吃了早饭。
questions.questionEn: Xiaoming ate breakfast today.

questions.question: 老师为什么说每个人都要早一点儿来？
questions.questionEn: Why did the teacher say everyone should come earlier?

questions.question: 老师可能不太相信小明明天六点起床。
questions.questionEn: The teacher may not quite believe Xiaoming will get up at six tomorrow.

lessons.description: Talk about sports, how well people do things, and how often
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: verb + 得 + adj / number + 次

grammar.title: How well: verb + 得 + adjective
grammar.note: 得 (de) links a verb to a description of how it is done. 她唱得很好 = She sings well. If the verb has an object, repeat the verb: 他打篮球打得很好.

grammar.title: How often: verb + number + 次
grammar.note: 次 (cì) counts occurrences. 去过两次 = been twice. 第一次 = the first time. With a separable verb like 游泳, 次 can split it: 游三次泳.

grammar.title: Together: 一起 + verb
grammar.note: 一起 (yìqǐ) goes before the verb. 和…一起 = together with someone: 我和哥哥一起打篮球.

sentences.en: What sport do you like?
I really like playing basketball.
She dances very well.

sentences.zh: 我一个星期跑三次步，身体很好。
sentences.en: I run three times a week, and I'm very healthy.

sentences.zh: 周末我们一起去踢足球吧！
sentences.en: Let's go play football together this weekend!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you exercise every day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 是的，我一个星期游四次泳。
dialogue.en: Yes, I swim four times a week.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How well do you swim?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 游得还可以。你喜欢什么运动？
dialogue.en: Not bad. What sport do you like?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢打篮球。明天我们一起去玩吧！
dialogue.en: I like basketball. Let's go play together tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure!

lines.zh: 我哥哥非常喜欢运动。
lines.en: My older brother really loves sports.

lines.zh: 他每个星期踢两次足球，打一次篮球。
lines.en: He plays football twice a week and basketball once.

lines.zh: 他跑得很快，踢得也很好。
lines.en: He runs fast and plays well too.

lines.zh: 早上他还去跑步，每天跑一个小时。
lines.en: In the mornings he also goes running, for an hour every day.

lines.zh: 我不太喜欢运动，所以身体不太好。
lines.en: I don't like sports much, so I'm not very healthy.

lines.zh: 哥哥说运动对身体好，让我和他一起去。
lines.en: My brother says exercise is good for you and asks me to go with him.

lines.zh: 现在我一个星期也跑三次步了。
lines.en: Now I go running three times a week too.

questions.question: 哥哥每个星期踢几次足球？
questions.questionEn: How many times a week does the brother play football?

questions.question: 哥哥跑得很慢。
questions.questionEn: The brother runs slowly.

questions.question: “我”为什么开始跑步？
questions.questionEn: Why did "I" start running?
options: 哥哥让我和他一起运动

questions.question: “我”现在比以前更喜欢运动了。
questions.questionEn: "I" now exercise more than before.

lines.zh: 我妹妹不喜欢打篮球，她喜欢跳舞。
lines.en: My younger sister doesn't like basketball; she likes dancing.

lines.zh: 她每个星期去学三次跳舞。
lines.en: She goes to dance class three times a week.

lines.zh: 她跳得非常漂亮，老师很喜欢她。
lines.en: She dances beautifully, and her teacher likes her a lot.

lines.zh: 我喜欢唱歌，可是我唱得不好。
lines.en: I like singing, but I don't sing well.

lines.zh: 妹妹说：“没关系，你唱得很高兴就好。”
lines.en: My sister said: "It doesn't matter, as long as you're happy singing."

lines.zh: 周末我们一起去玩，她跳舞，我唱歌。
lines.en: On weekends we go out together — she dances and I sing.

lines.zh: 我们玩得非常快乐。
lines.en: We have a really great time.

questions.question: 妹妹喜欢什么？
questions.questionEn: What does the younger sister like?

questions.question: “我”唱歌唱得很好。
questions.questionEn: "I" sing very well.

questions.question: 妹妹说的话是什么意思？
questions.questionEn: What does the sister mean by what she said?
options: 唱得好不好不重要，快乐最重要

questions.question: 周末他们一起出去玩。
questions.questionEn: On weekends they go out together.

lessons.description: Say how you travel, how far places are, and from where to where
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: A 离 B 远/近 / 从…到…

grammar.title: Distance: A 离 B + 远/近
grammar.note: 离 (lí) measures distance between two places: A 离 B 很远 = A is far from B. Ask with 远吗? or 远不远? Don't use 从 here — 从 is for movement, 离 is for distance.

grammar.title: From … to …: 从 A 到 B
grammar.pattern: 从我家到机场要一个小时。
grammar.note: 从 marks the starting point, 到 the end. It works for places and times: 从八点到十二点 (from 8 to 12).

grammar.title: How you go: 坐 / 骑 + vehicle + 去
grammar.pattern: 我坐公共汽车去，他骑自行车去。
grammar.note: Ride inside (bus, train, boat, plane) = 坐. Ride on top (bicycle, horse) = 骑 (qí). On foot = 走路去. The vehicle comes before the verb of motion.

sentences.en: Is your home far from here?

sentences.zh: 不远，走路十分钟就到了。
sentences.en: Not far — it's ten minutes on foot.
I ride my bike to work every day.
How do I get from here to the airport?
I'd like to buy two boat tickets.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, is the airport far from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 很远。走路去不行，你可以坐公共汽车。
dialogue.en: Very far. You can't walk; you can take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 从这儿到机场要多长时间？
dialogue.en: How long does it take from here to the airport?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: A little over an hour.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How much is the ticket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Two kuai. Take care on the way!

lines.zh: 我家离学校不太远，走路要二十分钟。
lines.en: My home isn't very far from school; it's a twenty-minute walk.

lines.zh: 天气好的时候，我骑自行车去学校。
lines.en: When the weather is nice, I ride my bike to school.

lines.zh: 骑自行车很快，十分钟就到了。
lines.en: Cycling is fast — I get there in ten minutes.

lines.zh: 下雨的时候，我坐公共汽车去。
lines.en: When it rains, I take the bus.

lines.zh: 从我家到学校，坐车要二十分钟。
lines.en: From my home to school, it takes twenty minutes by bus.

lines.zh: 因为路上车很多，所以公共汽车走得很慢。
lines.en: Because there's a lot of traffic, the bus goes slowly.

lines.zh: 我最喜欢骑自行车，也对身体好。
lines.en: I like cycling best; it's also good for my health.

questions.question: 天气好的时候，“我”怎么去学校？
questions.questionEn: How do I get to school when the weather is nice?

questions.question: 从“我”家到学校，骑自行车要二十分钟。
questions.questionEn: From my home to school, it takes twenty minutes by bike.

questions.question: 为什么坐公共汽车不快？
questions.questionEn: Why isn't taking the bus fast?

questions.question: “我”家离学校不太远。
questions.questionEn: My home isn't very far from school.

lines.zh: 上个星期，我和朋友坐船去玩。
lines.en: Last week, my friend and I went on a boat trip.

lines.zh: 我们早上七点从家里出发，先坐公共汽车到河边。
lines.en: We left home at 7 a.m. and first took a bus to the river.

lines.zh: 船票不贵，一张五十块钱，我买了两张。
lines.en: The boat tickets weren't expensive — fifty kuai each; I bought two.

lines.zh: 从早上九点到下午三点，我们都在船上。
lines.en: From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. we were on the boat.

lines.zh: 路很长，可是我们玩得很高兴。
lines.en: It was a long way, but we had a great time.

lines.zh: 船上有很多人，大家一起唱歌，一起看外边的山。
lines.en: There were lots of people on the boat; everyone sang and looked at the mountains together.

lines.zh: 中午我们在船上吃饭，鱼非常好吃。
lines.en: At noon we ate on the boat; the fish was delicious.

lines.zh: 下午我有点儿累，就在船上睡了一会儿。
lines.en: In the afternoon I was a bit tired, so I slept on the boat for a while.

lines.zh: 下船以后，我们走路去机场旁边的饭馆吃晚饭。
lines.en: After getting off, we walked to a restaurant next to the airport for dinner.

lines.zh: 朋友说：“下次我们还坐船吧！”
lines.en: My friend said: "Let's take the boat again next time!"

questions.question: 一张船票多少钱？
questions.questionEn: How much was one boat ticket?

questions.question: 他们在船上一共六个小时。
questions.questionEn: They were on the boat for six hours in total.

questions.question: “我”下午为什么在船上睡觉？
questions.questionEn: Why did I sleep on the boat in the afternoon?

questions.question: 从朋友最后的话，我们可以知道什么？
questions.questionEn: What can we tell from the friend's last words?

questions.question: 他们早上从机场坐船出发。
questions.questionEn: They set off on the boat from the airport in the morning.

lessons.description: Describe positions and directions; come in and go out
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 在…旁边 / 进来·出去 / 第 + number

grammar.title: Position: thing + 在 + place + 旁边/左边/右边
grammar.note: Place words come after the reference noun: 学校旁边 (next to the school), 门外 (outside the door). You can also flip it: 商店旁边是银行 = next to the store is the bank.

grammar.title: Direction: 进/出 + 来/去
grammar.note: 来 = toward the speaker, 去 = away from the speaker. If you're inside the room: 进来 (come in), 出去 (go out). If you're outside: 进去 (go in), 出来 (come out).

grammar.title: Ordinals: 第 + number
grammar.pattern: 第一个房间 / 第三天
grammar.note: Put 第 (dì) before any number to make it 'first, second…': 第一 (first), 第二 (second). Then add a measure word: 第一次 (the first time).

grammar.title: Towards: 向 + direction + verb
grammar.note: 向 (xiàng) = towards. 向前走 = walk forward. 向左 / 向右 = to the left / right. Common for giving directions.

sentences.zh: 我的房间在左边，哥哥的在右边。
sentences.en: My room is on the left; my brother's is on the right.
The teacher is waiting for you outside the classroom.
Come in! The door isn't closed.
What are you looking for?

sentences.zh: 向前走，第一个门就是厕所。
sentences.en: Walk ahead — the first door is the restroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 请问，王老师在哪个教室？
dialogue.en: Excuse me, which classroom is Teacher Wang in?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 在三楼。你向右走，第一个教室就是。
dialogue.en: On the third floor. Go right — it's the first classroom.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Thanks! Where's the elevator?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Right next to the door.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Teacher Wang, may I come in?

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.en: Please come in! What do you need me for?

lines.zh: 我的房间不大，可是很漂亮。
lines.en: My room isn't big, but it's very nice.

lines.zh: 进门，左边是床，右边是桌子。
lines.en: When you come in, the bed is on the left and the desk on the right.

lines.zh: 桌子旁边有一把椅子，我每天在这儿学习。
lines.en: There's a chair next to the desk; I study here every day.

lines.zh: 床旁边是我的小猫，它很喜欢睡觉。
lines.en: Next to the bed is my little cat; it loves sleeping.

lines.zh: 窗户外边有很多树，也有一家小商店。
lines.en: Outside the window there are lots of trees and a small shop.

lines.zh: 早上我喜欢在窗户旁边喝咖啡。
lines.en: In the morning I like drinking coffee by the window.

lines.zh: 我觉得我的房间是家里最好的地方。
lines.en: I think my room is the best place in the house.

questions.question: 进门，右边是什么？
questions.questionEn: When you come in, what's on the right?

questions.question: “我”的房间很大。
questions.questionEn: My room is very big.

questions.question: “我”可能在哪儿学习？
questions.questionEn: Where do I probably study?

questions.question: “我”很喜欢自己的房间。
questions.questionEn: I really like my own room.

lines.zh: 我的猫不见了，我在家里找它。
lines.en: My cat is missing; I'm looking for it at home.

lines.zh: 房间里没有，桌子下面也没有。
lines.en: It's not in the room, and not under the table either.

lines.zh: 我又去妈妈的房间找，床上也没有。
lines.en: I went to look in Mom's room; it wasn't on the bed either.

lines.zh: 我很着急，问妈妈：“您看见我的猫了吗？”
lines.en: I was worried and asked Mom: "Have you seen my cat?"

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“没看见。早上门开了一会儿，它可能出去了。”
lines.en: Mom said: "No. The door was open for a while this morning; it may have gone out."

lines.zh: 我出去找，第一个地方是门外。
lines.en: I went out to look; the first place was outside the door.

lines.zh: 它在门旁边睡觉呢！
lines.en: It was sleeping right next to the door!

lines.zh: 我笑着说：“快进来吧，外边太冷了。”
lines.en: I said with a smile: "Come in quickly, it's too cold outside."

lines.zh: 我马上抱起它，它身上很冷。
lines.en: I picked it up; its body was cold.

lines.zh: 它看了看我，慢慢地走进来了。
lines.en: It looked at me and slowly walked in.

lines.zh: 从那天以后，我每天出门都看看门关了没有。
lines.en: Since that day, every time I go out I check whether the door is shut.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“找到了就好，以后别让它一个人出去了。”
lines.en: Mom said: "Good that you found it. Don't let it go out alone again."

questions.question: “我”第一个去门外的哪儿找？
questions.questionEn: Where outside did I look first?

questions.question: 猫在妈妈的床上睡觉。
questions.questionEn: The cat was sleeping on Mom's bed.

questions.question: 猫为什么在外边？
questions.questionEn: Why was the cat outside?

questions.question: “我”现在为什么每天看门关了没有？
questions.questionEn: Why do I now check the door every day?

questions.question: 猫找到以后，它自己走进了家。
questions.questionEn: After being found, the cat walked into the house by itself.

lessons.description: Order food and drinks, make suggestions and say what tastes good
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: …吧 / 要 + noun / 好 + verb

grammar.title: Suggestions: …吧
grammar.note: 吧 (ba) at the end turns a statement into a soft suggestion: 'let's…'. 走吧! = Let's go! It can also mean 'I suppose…?': 你是老师吧? = You're a teacher, right?

grammar.title: Ordering: 要 + amount + food
grammar.pattern: 我要一杯咖啡和两个鸡蛋。
grammar.note: 要 (yào) = to want / to order. 你要什么? = What would you like? Add 来 for a casual order: 来一碗米饭 = 'bring a bowl of rice'.

grammar.title: Good to …: 好 + verb
grammar.pattern: 好吃 / 好喝 / 好看
grammar.note: 好 before a sense verb makes an adjective: 好吃 (tasty), 好喝 (nice to drink), 好看 (good-looking), 好玩 (fun). Negative: 不好吃.

sentences.en: Welcome! Please sit down.
Waiter, we'd like to order.
The lamb here is really delicious.

sentences.zh: 我早上喝牛奶，不喝咖啡。
sentences.en: In the morning I drink milk, not coffee.

sentences.zh: 天太热了，我们吃西瓜吧！
sentences.en: It's so hot — let's eat watermelon!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Welcome! What would you like to eat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我要一个鱼和一个鸡蛋汤。
dialogue.en: I'd like a fish and an egg soup.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.zh: 我想吃羊肉。这儿的羊肉好吃吗？
dialogue.en: I want lamb. Is the lamb here good?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 非常好吃！你们要喝什么？
dialogue.en: Very good! What would you like to drink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Two cups of tea, I guess.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Okay, one moment please.

lines.zh: 我每天早上都吃两个鸡蛋。
lines.en: I eat two eggs every morning.

lines.zh: 我还喝一杯牛奶，有时候也吃一个苹果。
lines.en: I also drink a glass of milk, and sometimes eat an apple.

lines.zh: 爸爸不喝牛奶，他喜欢喝咖啡。
lines.en: Dad doesn't drink milk; he likes coffee.

lines.zh: 他每天早上都喝两杯咖啡，可是不吃鸡蛋。
lines.en: He drinks two cups of coffee every morning but doesn't eat eggs.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：早饭要吃好！
lines.en: Mom says: you must eat a good breakfast!

lines.zh: 她让爸爸少喝咖啡，多吃东西。
lines.en: She tells Dad to drink less coffee and eat more.

lines.zh: 现在爸爸每天也吃一个鸡蛋了。
lines.en: Now Dad eats an egg every day too.

questions.question: “我”每天早上吃几个鸡蛋？
questions.questionEn: How many eggs do I eat every morning?

questions.question: 爸爸喜欢喝牛奶。
questions.questionEn: Dad likes drinking milk.

questions.question: 妈妈为什么让爸爸多吃东西？
questions.questionEn: Why does Mom tell Dad to eat more?

questions.question: 爸爸听了妈妈的话。
questions.questionEn: Dad listened to Mom.

lines.zh: 今天晚上我们去饭馆吃饭吧。
lines.en: Let's go eat at a restaurant tonight.

lines.zh: 好啊！我们去学校旁边那个新饭馆吧。
lines.en: Sure! Let's go to that new restaurant next to the school.

lines.zh: 服务员说：“欢迎！你们想吃什么？”
lines.en: The waiter said: "Welcome! What would you like?"

lines.zh: 我问他：“你们这儿什么最好吃？”
lines.en: I asked him: "What's best here?"

lines.zh: 服务员说这儿的鱼最好吃。
lines.en: The waiter said the fish here is the best.

lines.zh: 我朋友说：“我不太喜欢吃鱼，我们再要一个羊肉吧。”
lines.en: My friend said: "I don't really like fish; let's also get a lamb dish."

lines.zh: 我们要了一个鱼，一个羊肉，还要了两杯茶。
lines.en: We ordered a fish, a lamb dish and two cups of tea.

lines.zh: 鱼真好吃，羊肉也很好吃，我们都吃完了。
lines.en: The fish was really good, and the lamb was good too — we finished everything.

lines.zh: 吃完饭，服务员送给我们一个西瓜。
lines.en: After the meal, the waiter gave us a watermelon for free.

lines.zh: 服务员说：“这个西瓜是送的，欢迎你们再来！”
lines.en: The waiter said: "The watermelon is on the house — come again!"

lines.zh: 我们觉得这个饭馆很好，下次还来吧！
lines.en: We think this restaurant is great — let's come again next time!

questions.question: 服务员说什么最好吃？
questions.questionEn: What did the waiter say was best?

questions.question: 西瓜是他们自己买的。
questions.questionEn: They bought the watermelon themselves.

questions.question: 他们为什么还要了羊肉？
questions.questionEn: Why did they also order lamb?

questions.question: 这篇短文主要说什么？
questions.questionEn: What is this passage mainly about?

questions.question: 他们觉得这个饭馆的菜很好吃。
questions.questionEn: They thought the food at this restaurant was tasty.

lessons.description: Handle prices in hundreds and thousands, bargain and buy gifts
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 多少钱一公斤 / 别 + verb / 给 + person

grammar.title: Price per unit: 多少钱一 + measure
grammar.pattern: 苹果多少钱一公斤？— 十元一公斤。
grammar.note: Chinese puts the price first and the unit second: 十块一公斤 = ten kuai per kilo. 元 (yuán) is the written unit; in speech people say 块 (kuài).

grammar.title: Big numbers: 百 and 千
grammar.note: 百 = hundred, 千 = thousand. Use 两 instead of 二 before 百 and 千: 两百, 两千. A zero in the middle is spoken: 一百零五 (105).

grammar.title: Don't: 别 + verb
grammar.note: 别 (bié) = don't. It's softer and more common in speech than 不要. 别客气 = you're welcome / don't be polite.

grammar.title: For someone: 给 + person + verb
grammar.pattern: 我给妈妈买了一个手表。
grammar.note: 给 before a person means 'for / to'. 送给 = give as a gift: 这是我送给你的. 给 can also be the main verb: 给我 = give me.

sentences.en: How much is watermelon per kilo?
This watch is 1,200 yuan.

sentences.zh: 太贵了，能便宜一点儿吗？
sentences.en: Too expensive — can you make it a bit cheaper?

sentences.zh: 别买这件，你穿红色的更漂亮。
sentences.en: Don't buy this one; you look better in red.

sentences.zh: 我想给妈妈买一个生日礼物。
sentences.en: I want to buy Mom a birthday present.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好，这个手表卖多少钱？
dialogue.en: Hi, how much is this watch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: 2,800 yuan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Too expensive! Make it cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: 2,500 — that's as low as I can go.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Okay. I'm giving it to my husband.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: He'll definitely love it!

lines.zh: 这个商店的水果很便宜。
lines.en: The fruit in this shop is cheap.

lines.zh: 苹果八元一公斤，西瓜三元一公斤。
lines.en: Apples are 8 yuan a kilo; watermelon is 3 yuan a kilo.

lines.zh: 别的商店的苹果十二元一公斤。
lines.en: At other shops apples are 12 yuan a kilo.

lines.zh: 我买了两公斤苹果，一个大西瓜。
lines.en: I bought two kilos of apples and a big watermelon.

lines.zh: 西瓜很大，有八公斤。
lines.en: The watermelon was big — eight kilos.

lines.zh: 一共四十块钱。
lines.en: Forty kuai altogether.

lines.zh: 卖水果的人说：“欢迎再来！”
lines.en: The fruit seller said: "Come again!"

lines.zh: 我想，以后我还来这儿买水果。
lines.en: I think I'll keep coming here to buy fruit.

questions.question: 这个商店的苹果多少钱一公斤？
questions.questionEn: How much are apples per kilo in this shop?

questions.question: 这个商店的苹果比别的商店贵。
questions.questionEn: Apples in this shop are more expensive than at other shops.

questions.question: “我”为什么以后还想来这儿？
questions.questionEn: Why do I want to come here again?

questions.question: “我”一共花了四十块钱。
questions.questionEn: I spent forty kuai in total.

lines.zh: 明天是爸爸的生日，我想给他买一个手表。
lines.en: Tomorrow is Dad's birthday; I want to buy him a watch.

lines.zh: 下午我和妈妈一起去商店。
lines.en: In the afternoon Mom and I went to the shop together.

lines.zh: 卖手表的人给我们看了两个手表。
lines.en: The watch seller showed us two watches.

lines.zh: 第一个手表是黑色的，三千元，太贵了。
lines.en: The first watch was black and cost 3,000 yuan — too expensive.

lines.zh: 第二个是白色的，只要五百元，也很好看。
lines.en: The second was white, only 500 yuan, and it looked great.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“你爸爸不喜欢黑色，白色的更好。”
lines.en: Mom said: "Your dad doesn't like black; the white one is better."

lines.zh: 我用我的钱买了第二个，妈妈给我一百元买了一件红衣服。
lines.en: I bought the second with my own money, and Mom gave me 100 yuan to buy a red shirt.

lines.zh: 那件红衣服也是送给爸爸的。
lines.en: That red shirt was also for Dad.

lines.zh: 回家的路上，妈妈说：别告诉爸爸，明天送给他！
lines.en: On the way home, Mom said: don't tell Dad — give it to him tomorrow!

lines.zh: 我希望爸爸明天看见礼物会很高兴。
lines.en: I hope Dad will be happy when he sees the gifts tomorrow.

questions.question: “我”买的手表多少钱？
questions.questionEn: How much was the watch I bought?

questions.question: “我”买了黑色的手表。
questions.questionEn: I bought the black watch.

questions.question: 为什么买第二个手表？
questions.questionEn: Why did they buy the second watch?
options: 便宜、好看，爸爸也喜欢白色

questions.question: 妈妈为什么说“别告诉爸爸”？
questions.questionEn: Why did Mom say "don't tell Dad"?
options: 想让爸爸明天高兴一下

questions.question: “我”和妈妈一共给爸爸买了两件礼物。
questions.questionEn: Mom and I bought Dad two gifts in total.

lessons.description: Describe the weather, give opinions, guess and hope
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 觉得 / 可能 / 希望

grammar.title: Opinion: 觉得 + clause
grammar.note: 觉得 (juéde) = to feel / to think. It introduces a whole sentence: 我觉得这本书很好. Ask someone's view: 你觉得怎么样?

grammar.title: Maybe: 可能 + verb
grammar.note: 可能 (kěnéng) before the verb = maybe / probably. 他可能不来 = He might not come. 可能 can also stand alone as 'possible': 不可能! = Impossible!

grammar.title: Hope: 希望 + clause
grammar.note: 希望 (xīwàng) takes a full sentence after it, like 觉得. 希望你快乐 = I hope you're happy.

grammar.title: Soon: 快…了
grammar.note: 快 + verb/adj + 了 = 'about to…'. 快八点了 = It's almost eight. 天快黑了 = It's getting dark. Also: 要…了 means the same.

sentences.en: It's sunny today — the weather is really nice!
It's clouded over; it's about to rain.

sentences.zh: 我觉得北京的冬天很冷。
sentences.en: I think Beijing's winter is very cold.
It might snow tomorrow.
I hope it doesn't rain this weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What's the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 早上是晴天，下午可能会阴。
dialogue.en: Sunny this morning; it may cloud over this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you think it'll rain?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It might. Take an umbrella.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I really hope it snows tomorrow!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Impossible — it's June!

lines.zh: 昨天天很阴，非常冷。
lines.en: Yesterday was overcast and very cold.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：今天晚上可能下雪。
lines.en: Mom said: it might snow tonight.

lines.zh: 我觉得不会下雪，因为去年冬天没下雪。
lines.en: I didn't think it would snow, because it didn't snow last winter.

lines.zh: 早上起床，外边都是白色的！
lines.en: When I got up this morning, everything outside was white!

lines.zh: 我和弟弟穿好衣服，就出去玩雪了。
lines.en: My younger brother and I got dressed and went out to play in the snow.

lines.zh: 我们在雪里跑，玩得非常高兴。
lines.en: We ran in the snow and had a wonderful time.

lines.zh: 我觉得下雪的时候真漂亮。
lines.en: I think it's really beautiful when it snows.

questions.question: 昨天天气怎么样？
questions.questionEn: What was the weather like yesterday?

questions.question: “我”以前觉得今天会下雪。
questions.questionEn: Before, I thought it would snow today.

questions.question: “外边都是白色的”是什么意思？
questions.questionEn: What does "everything outside was white" mean?

questions.question: “我”和弟弟在外边玩雪。
questions.questionEn: My brother and I played in the snow outside.

lines.zh: 下午我和妈妈去商店，天很阴。
lines.en: In the afternoon Mom and I went to the shop; it was overcast.

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“快下雨了，我们走快一点儿吧。”
lines.en: Mom said: "It's about to rain — let's walk faster."

lines.zh: 可是我们还没到家，雨就开始下了。
lines.en: But before we got home, it started raining.

lines.zh: 我们坐上了一辆出租车。
lines.en: We got into a taxi.

lines.zh: 路上人很多，车开得很慢。
lines.en: The road was crowded and the car moved slowly.

lines.zh: 司机说：“下雨的时候，每个人都想坐车，所以路上车很多。”
lines.en: The driver said: "When it rains everyone wants a ride, so there are lots of cars."

lines.zh: 我说：“师傅，您能开快一点儿吗？”
lines.en: I said: "Driver, could you drive a bit faster?"

lines.zh: 司机笑着说：“雨天开车要慢一点儿，快了不安全。”
lines.en: The driver said with a smile: "On rainy days you should drive slower; going fast isn't safe."

lines.zh: 妈妈说：“他说得对，我们不着急。”
lines.en: Mom said: "He's right; we're not in a hurry."

lines.zh: 一个小时以后，我们才到家。
lines.en: An hour later, we finally got home.

lines.zh: 我们在车上看外边的雨，也觉得很好看。
lines.en: We watched the rain outside from the car and found it pretty too.

lines.zh: 我希望明天是晴天，我们可以走路去公园。
lines.en: I hope tomorrow will be sunny so we can walk to the park.

questions.question: 他们为什么坐出租车？
questions.questionEn: Why did they take a taxi?

questions.question: 出租车开得很快。
questions.questionEn: The taxi drove fast.

questions.question: 司机为什么开得慢？
questions.questionEn: Why did the driver drive slowly?

questions.question: “我们不着急”说明妈妈觉得怎么样？
questions.questionEn: What does "we're not in a hurry" show about Mom's view?

questions.question: “我”希望明天天气好。
questions.questionEn: I hope the weather is good tomorrow.

lessons.description: Say what's wrong, give reasons, and follow advice
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 因为…所以… / 让 + person + verb

grammar.title: Cause and effect: 因为…，所以…
grammar.pattern: 因为我生病了，所以没去上班。
grammar.note: 因为 (because) introduces the reason, 所以 (so) the result. Unlike English, Chinese happily uses both in one sentence. Either half can also stand alone.

grammar.title: Make / let someone: 让 + person + verb
grammar.note: 让 (ràng) = to let / to tell someone to do something. 妈妈让我早点儿睡觉 = Mom told me to sleep early. 让我看看 = Let me see.

grammar.title: Tell: 告诉 + person + information
grammar.pattern: 请告诉我你的电话号码。
grammar.note: 告诉 (gàosu) takes the person first, then what you tell them. 他告诉我他生病了 = He told me he was sick. Don't use 说 with a person object this way.

grammar.title: Why: 为什么
grammar.note: 为什么 (wèishénme) goes before the verb, after the subject. Answer with 因为… 为 (wèi) alone means 'for (the sake of)': 为你高兴 = happy for you.

sentences.en: What's wrong? Where does it hurt?
I'm sick, and my eyes hurt.

sentences.zh: 医生让我每天吃三次药。
sentences.en: The doctor told me to take medicine three times a day.

sentences.zh: 因为太累了，所以他今天没去上班。
sentences.en: Because he was too tired, he didn't go to work today.
Why didn't you tell me?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你今天为什么没来上课？
dialogue.en: Why didn't you come to class today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 因为我生病了，所以去医院了。
dialogue.en: Because I got sick, so I went to the hospital.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What did the doctor say?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 医生说我太累了，让我多休息。
dialogue.en: The doctor said I'm too tired and told me to rest more.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you need to take medicine?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 要，每天两次。明天我告诉老师。
dialogue.en: Yes, twice a day. I'll tell the teacher tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我每天看手机看很长时间。
lines.en: I look at my phone for a long time every day.

lines.zh: 晚上我也在床上看手机，很晚才睡觉。
lines.en: At night I also look at my phone in bed and go to sleep very late.

lines.zh: 昨天我的眼睛很不舒服。
lines.en: Yesterday my eyes felt really uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我去医院看医生。
lines.en: I went to the hospital to see a doctor.

lines.zh: 医生告诉我：因为你看手机太多，所以眼睛累了。
lines.en: The doctor told me: because you look at your phone too much, your eyes are tired.

lines.zh: 医生让我少看手机，多休息。
lines.en: The doctor told me to look at my phone less and rest more.

lines.zh: 现在我每天晚上十点就睡觉了。
lines.en: Now I go to sleep at ten every night.

questions.question: “我”的眼睛为什么不舒服？
questions.questionEn: Why were my eyes uncomfortable?

questions.question: 医生让“我”多看手机。
questions.questionEn: The doctor told me to look at my phone more.

questions.question: “我”现在为什么早一点儿睡觉？
questions.questionEn: Why do I go to sleep earlier now?

questions.question: 以前“我”晚上睡得很晚。
questions.questionEn: Before, I went to sleep late at night.

lines.zh: 我哥哥工作非常忙，每天都很累。
lines.en: My older brother is very busy at work and tired every day.

lines.zh: 他早上七点上班，晚上十点才回家。
lines.en: He starts work at 7 a.m. and doesn't get home until 10 p.m.

lines.zh: 因为没有时间，所以他常常不吃早饭。
lines.en: Because he has no time, he often skips breakfast.

lines.zh: 上个星期他生病了，身体很不舒服。
lines.en: Last week he got sick and felt really unwell.

lines.zh: 他去医院看病，医生让他吃药，在家休息。
lines.en: He went to the hospital; the doctor told him to take medicine and rest at home.

lines.zh: 他吃了药，在家休息了三天。
lines.en: He took medicine and rested at home for three days.

lines.zh: 妈妈每天给他做饭，还让他多喝水。
lines.en: Mom cooked for him every day and had him drink lots of water.

lines.zh: 三天以后，他的身体好多了。
lines.en: After three days he felt much better.

lines.zh: 哥哥问：“为什么我会生病？”
lines.en: My brother asked: "Why did I get sick?"

lines.zh: 妈妈告诉他：“因为你太累了，工作没有身体重要！”
lines.en: Mom told him: "Because you were too tired. Work isn't as important as your health!"

lines.zh: 现在哥哥每天都吃早饭，周末也去跑步。
lines.en: Now my brother eats breakfast every day and goes running on weekends.

questions.question: 哥哥在家休息了几天？
questions.questionEn: How many days did the brother rest at home?

questions.question: 哥哥以前每天都吃早饭。
questions.questionEn: The brother used to eat breakfast every day.

questions.question: 妈妈觉得哥哥为什么会生病？
questions.questionEn: Why does Mom think the brother got sick?

questions.question: 这个故事最想告诉我们什么？
questions.questionEn: What is the main message of this story?

questions.question: 生病以后，哥哥的生活变了。
questions.questionEn: After getting sick, the brother changed his habits.

lessons.description: Talk about classes and tests; say whether you understood or got it right
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: verb + 懂/完/错 / 可以 / 什么意思

grammar.title: Result complements: verb + 懂 / 完 / 错 / 好
grammar.pattern: 我听懂了。/ 这个题我做错了。
grammar.note: A second verb or adjective after the main verb shows the result: 看懂 (read and understand), 做完 (finish doing), 写错 (write wrongly), 准备好 (get fully ready). Negate with 没: 我没听懂.

grammar.title: What does … mean: …是什么意思？
grammar.note: 意思 (yìsi) = meaning. 我不懂你的意思 = I don't get what you mean. Useful phrase: 不好意思 = sorry / excuse me (embarrassed).

grammar.title: Permission: 可以 + verb
grammar.pattern: 老师，我可以问一个问题吗？
grammar.note: 可以 (kěyǐ) = may / can (allowed). Answer yes with 可以, no with 不可以 or 不行. For skills learned, use 会 instead: 我会说中文.

sentences.zh: 明天有考试，我要好好准备。
sentences.en: There's an exam tomorrow; I need to prepare well.

sentences.zh: 老师，我没听懂，可以再说一次吗？
sentences.en: Teacher, I didn't understand — can you say it again?
I got the third question wrong.
What does this word mean?
Thank you for your help!

sentences.zh: 我不知道这个问题怎么回答，我去问老师。
sentences.en: I don't know how to answer this question; I'll go ask the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you ready for the exam?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 还没有。很多题我看不懂。
dialogue.en: Not yet. I can't understand a lot of the questions.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 哪个问题？我可以帮助你。
dialogue.en: Which question? I can help you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: What does this sentence mean?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Look — answer it like this and it's correct.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I get it! Thanks so much.

lines.zh: 我们每个星期有三次汉语课。
lines.en: We have Chinese class three times a week.

lines.zh: 老师问问题，我们回答。
lines.en: The teacher asks questions and we answer.

lines.zh: 刚开始的时候，老师说的话我很多都听不懂。
lines.en: At first, I couldn't understand much of what the teacher said.

lines.zh: 我听不懂的时候，就问老师。
lines.en: When I don't understand, I ask the teacher.

lines.zh: 老师说：“没关系，有问题就问。”
lines.en: The teacher said: "No problem — ask whenever you have a question."

lines.zh: 我每天晚上也看一会儿中文书。
lines.en: I also read some Chinese books every evening.

lines.zh: 现在我可以看懂中文报纸了！
lines.en: Now I can read Chinese newspapers!

questions.question: 他们每个星期有几次汉语课？
questions.questionEn: How many Chinese classes do they have a week?

questions.question: 刚开始的时候，“我”都听得懂。
questions.questionEn: At first, I understood everything.

questions.question: “我”现在为什么可以看懂报纸了？
questions.questionEn: Why can I read newspapers now?
options: 我常常问问题，也每天看书

questions.question: 老师很喜欢学生问问题。
questions.questionEn: The teacher is happy for students to ask questions.

lines.zh: 今天上午我们有汉语考试。
lines.en: This morning we had a Chinese exam.

lines.zh: 昨天晚上我准备了三个小时，十二点才睡觉。
lines.en: Last night I prepared for three hours and only went to bed at twelve.

lines.zh: 今天的考试有二十个题。
lines.en: Today's exam had twenty questions.

lines.zh: 题不太难，我都看懂了。
lines.en: The questions weren't too hard; I understood them all.

lines.zh: 我用了一个小时就做完了。
lines.en: I finished it in just one hour.

lines.zh: 可是我做错了两个题。
lines.en: But I got two questions wrong.

lines.zh: 一个是因为我太快了，没有看完题就回答了。
lines.en: One was because I was too fast and answered before reading the whole question.

lines.zh: 还有一个字，我不知道它是什么意思。
lines.en: The other had a character I didn't know the meaning of.

lines.zh: 老师说：“你考得不错，可是做题要慢一点儿。”
lines.en: The teacher said: "You did well, but you should do the questions more slowly."

lines.zh: 考试以后我问老师，老师告诉我那个字是“帮助”的“助”。
lines.en: After the exam I asked the teacher; she told me the character was 助 as in 帮助.

lines.zh: 下次我要准备得更好，也要看完题再回答。
lines.en: Next time I'll prepare better and read the whole question before answering.

questions.question: “我”做错了几个题？
questions.questionEn: How many questions did I get wrong?

questions.question: “我”用了两个小时做完考试。
questions.questionEn: It took me two hours to finish the exam.

questions.question: “我”为什么做错了一个题？
questions.questionEn: Why did I get one question wrong?

questions.question: 老师说“做题要慢一点儿”是什么意思？
questions.questionEn: What did the teacher mean by "do the questions more slowly"?

questions.question: “我”觉得这次考试的题非常难。
questions.questionEn: I thought the questions on this exam were very hard.

lessons.description: Describe what people are doing right now and how things are
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 正在…呢 / verb + 着

grammar.title: In progress: (正)在 + verb + (呢)
grammar.note: 正在 (zhèngzài) before a verb = 'right now, in the middle of'. 呢 at the end adds a friendly tone. Shorter forms: 在 + verb, or just verb + 呢. Negate with 没在: 我没在看电视.

grammar.title: Ongoing state: verb + 着
grammar.note: 着 (zhe) shows a lasting state: 门开着 (the door is open), 他穿着红衣服 (he's wearing red). Verb1 + 着 + verb2 = do verb2 while verb1: 笑着说 (say with a smile).

grammar.title: Wishes: 祝 + person + wish
grammar.note: 祝 (zhù) = to wish. 祝你身体好 (wishing you good health), 祝你考试好 (good luck on your exam).

sentences.en: Today is my birthday!
Happy birthday to you!
Mom is making a cake right now.
She said with a smile: thank you, everyone!

sentences.zh: 你给我打电话的时候，我正在开会。
sentences.en: When you called me, I was in a meeting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, what are you doing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我正在准备晚饭。有什么事情吗？
dialogue.en: I'm preparing dinner. What's up?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 明天是小王的生日，我们一起去吧！
dialogue.en: Tomorrow is Xiao Wang's birthday — let's go together!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Great! What are you giving her?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I want to give her a phone.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: She'll definitely be happy!

lines.zh: 今天是我妹妹的生日，她八岁了。
lines.en: Today is my younger sister's birthday; she's turned eight.

lines.zh: 她早上一起床就问：“我的礼物呢？”
lines.en: As soon as she got up she asked: "Where's my present?"

lines.zh: 爸爸正在做饭，妈妈正在买蛋糕。
lines.en: Dad is cooking and Mom is buying a cake.

lines.zh: 我正在给妹妹写一张生日卡。
lines.en: I'm writing a birthday card for my sister.

lines.zh: 晚上，我们一起吃饭，一起唱生日歌。
lines.en: In the evening we eat together and sing the birthday song.

lines.zh: 我送给妹妹一本书。
lines.en: I gave my sister a book.

lines.zh: 她笑着说：谢谢哥哥！
lines.en: She said with a smile: thanks, big brother!

lines.zh: 我们都说：“祝你生日快乐！”
lines.en: We all said: "Happy birthday!"

questions.question: 妹妹今年几岁？
questions.questionEn: How old is the sister this year?

questions.question: 妈妈正在做饭。
questions.questionEn: Mom is cooking.

questions.question: 妹妹为什么笑？
questions.questionEn: Why did the sister smile?

questions.question: “我”是妹妹的哥哥。
questions.questionEn: "I" am the sister's older brother.

lines.zh: 今天是我的生日，我请朋友们来家里玩。
lines.en: Today is my birthday, and I invited friends over.

lines.zh: 晚上七点，朋友们都来了。
lines.en: At seven in the evening, all the friends arrived.

lines.zh: 他们送给我很多礼物，有书，也有手表。
lines.en: They gave me lots of gifts — books and a watch too.

lines.zh: 大家一起唱歌，一起吃蛋糕。
lines.en: Everyone sang together and ate cake together.

lines.zh: 小李一直在看手机，他正在等女朋友的电话。
lines.en: Xiao Li kept looking at his phone; he was waiting for his girlfriend's call.

lines.zh: 我问他：“有什么事情吗？”
lines.en: I asked him: "Is something up?"

lines.zh: 他说：“她说今天晚上给我打电话，可是还没打。”
lines.en: He said: "She said she'd call me tonight, but she hasn't yet."

lines.zh: 九点的时候，门开着，一个女孩子笑着走进来了。
lines.en: At nine, the door was open and a girl walked in smiling.

lines.zh: 原来是小李的女朋友，她也来给我过生日！
lines.en: It turned out to be Xiao Li's girlfriend — she came for my birthday too!

lines.zh: 小李非常高兴，大家都笑了。
lines.en: Xiao Li was overjoyed and everyone laughed.

lines.zh: 这是我最快乐的一个生日！
lines.en: This was my happiest birthday ever!

questions.question: 朋友们几点来的？
questions.questionEn: What time did the friends arrive?

questions.question: 小李一直在看电视。
questions.questionEn: Xiao Li kept watching TV.

questions.question: 小李为什么一直看手机？
questions.questionEn: Why did Xiao Li keep looking at his phone?

questions.question: 女朋友为什么没有打电话？
questions.questionEn: Why didn't the girlfriend call?
options: 她来这儿了，想让小李高兴一下

questions.question: “我”觉得这个生日很快乐。
questions.questionEn: I thought this birthday was very happy.

lessons.description: Share travel experiences, contrast ideas, and review all of HSK 2
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: verb + 过 / 虽然…但是… / 还

grammar.title: Experience: verb + 过
grammar.pattern: 我去过北京。/ 我没吃过羊肉。
grammar.note: 过 (guo) after a verb = 'have ever done'. It talks about experience, not one specific time. Negate with 没 + verb + 过. Ask: 你去过…吗? or 你去没去过…?

grammar.title: Although … but …: 虽然…，但是…
grammar.note: 虽然 (suīrán) introduces a concession, 但是 (dànshì) the contrast. Like 因为…所以…, Chinese uses both halves together — English drops one of them.

grammar.title: Still / also: 还
grammar.pattern: 我还想去上海。/ 他还没来。
grammar.note: 还 (hái) = still, also, in addition. 还有 = there's also. 还没 + verb = not yet. 还是 in a question = or: 你喝茶还是咖啡?

grammar.title: Comparison review: A 比 B + adj (+ amount)
grammar.note: From Lesson 12: A 比 B + adj. Add 多了 or 一点儿 after the adjective to say 'much' or 'a bit': 今天比昨天冷一点儿. Never put 很 before the adjective in a 比 sentence.

sentences.en: Have you ever been to China?

sentences.zh: 去年我和家人去上海旅游了。
sentences.en: Last year my family and I travelled to Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 我们住的宾馆离机场很近。
sentences.en: The hotel we stayed at was close to the airport.

sentences.zh: 虽然路很长，但是我们玩得很高兴。
sentences.en: Although the journey was long, we had a great time.

sentences.zh: 坐飞机比坐火车快多了。
sentences.en: Flying is much faster than taking the train.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Have you been to Beijing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 去过两次。去年还去了一次。
dialogue.en: Twice. I went again last year.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How is Beijing?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 虽然冬天很冷，但是非常漂亮。
dialogue.en: Although the winter is cold, it's very beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我还没去过，明年想去旅游。
dialogue.en: I haven't been yet; I want to travel there next year.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 好啊！我可以告诉你住哪个宾馆。
dialogue.en: Great! I can tell you which hotel to stay at.

lines.zh: 去年夏天，我和朋友去北京旅游了。
lines.en: Last summer, my friend and I travelled to Beijing.

lines.zh: 我们坐了十个小时的火车。
lines.en: We took a ten-hour train ride.

lines.zh: 飞机比火车快多了，但是票也贵多了。
lines.en: Planes are much faster than trains, but the tickets are much pricier too.

lines.zh: 虽然路很长，但是我们一点儿也不累。
lines.en: Although the trip was long, we weren't tired at all.

lines.zh: 我们在火车上唱歌、看书，还认识了新朋友。
lines.en: On the train we sang, read and even made new friends.

lines.zh: 我们住的宾馆很便宜，房间也很大。
lines.en: Our hotel was cheap and the room was big too.

lines.zh: 宾馆离车站很近，走路只要十分钟。
lines.en: The hotel was close to the station — only a ten-minute walk.

lines.zh: 我们去过很多地方，每天都走很长的路。
lines.en: We went to many places and walked a long way every day.

lines.zh: 在北京，我们吃过很多好吃的东西。
lines.en: In Beijing we ate lots of delicious food.

lines.zh: 虽然天气很热，但是我们每天都出去玩。
lines.en: Although it was hot, we went out every day.

lines.zh: 那是我第一次去北京，我还想再去！
lines.en: That was my first time in Beijing — I want to go again!

questions.question: 他们怎么去北京？
questions.questionEn: How did they get to Beijing?

questions.question: 他们住的宾馆很贵。
questions.questionEn: Their hotel was expensive.

questions.question: 他们为什么不坐飞机？
questions.questionEn: Why didn't they fly?

questions.question: “我还想再去”说明了什么？
questions.questionEn: What does "I want to go again" show?

questions.question: 在北京的时候，天气很冷。
questions.questionEn: It was cold while they were in Beijing.

lines.zh: 小王，你去过上海吗？
lines.en: Xiao Wang, have you been to Shanghai?

lines.zh: 没有。我去过很多地方，可是没去过上海。
lines.en: No. I've been to many places, but never Shanghai.

lines.zh: 你去过哪儿？
lines.en: Where have you been?

lines.zh: 我去过北京和西安，还坐船去过很多小地方。
lines.en: I've been to Beijing and Xi'an, and taken boats to lots of small places.

lines.zh: 我朋友说上海比北京热，人也比北京多。
lines.en: My friend says Shanghai is hotter than Beijing, and more crowded too.

lines.zh: 她还说上海的鱼非常好吃。
lines.en: She also says the fish in Shanghai is delicious.

lines.zh: 我听说上海的路很长，可以坐船看外边的高楼。
lines.en: I hear Shanghai's roads are long, and you can take a boat to see the tall buildings.

lines.zh: 虽然我没去过，但是我很想去看看。
lines.en: Although I haven't been, I really want to go and see it.

lines.zh: 我去过两次，上海真的很漂亮！
lines.en: I've been twice — Shanghai is really beautiful!

lines.zh: 我也觉得上海比北京热，可是那儿的东西非常好吃。
lines.en: I also found Shanghai hotter than Beijing, but the food there is great.

lines.zh: 那你明年还想去吗？我们可以一起去。
lines.en: Then do you want to go again next year? We can go together.

lines.zh: 好啊！我希望明年可以去上海看看。
lines.en: Great! I hope I can go and see Shanghai next year.

questions.question: 小王没去过哪儿？
questions.questionEn: Where hasn't Xiao Wang been?

questions.question: 朋友说上海比北京冷。
questions.questionEn: The friend says Shanghai is colder than Beijing.

questions.question: 另一个人去过上海几次？
questions.questionEn: How many times has the other person been to Shanghai?

questions.question: 他们最后决定了什么？
questions.questionEn: What did they decide at the end?

questions.question: 小王很想去上海。
questions.questionEn: Xiao Wang really wants to go to Shanghai.
